blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever sobre ética aplicada a partir de uma notícia, identificando atribuições e atenuações, e ajustando o ritmo da leitura.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.headline: University Ethics Board Weighs Limits on Predictive Admissions Software
paras: Hartwell University’s ethics board **convened** on Tuesday to consider whether an algorithm should **screen** applicants. A faculty member, Dr. Nadia Ferro, **argued** that the software, which **ranks** candidates by predicted success, **risks entrenching** existing inequalities. “A prediction is **not a neutral fact**,” she **said**.

The registrar, however, **maintained** that human readers would **retain the final say**. The board **is expected** to publish its recommendations next month, though **a spokesperson declined to say** whether a ban is under consideration. **According to** minutes seen by this newspaper, members **were divided**.

items.q: The board has already banned the software.
items.why: though a spokesperson declined to say.

items.q: Dr. Ferro thinks predictions are neutral facts.
The board is expected to publish its recommendations next month.

blocks.body: A notícia cuida de **atribuir** cada afirmação a uma fonte. **Argue** e **maintain** indicam posição; **claim** sugere dúvida; **say** é neutro. A leitura em voz alta mantém **ritmo regular** e queda de tom no fim da frase.

items.s: Dr. Ferro ___ that the software risks entrenching inequality. (argue)
The registrar ___ that humans would have the final say. (maintain)
___ to minutes seen by this newspaper, members were divided. (according)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Weigh the options.** — Pesar as opções.
**Go on record.** — Declarar oficialmente.
**Off the record.** — Em off.
**No comment.** — Sem comentários.
**Split down the middle.** — Dividido ao meio.
**Behind closed doors.** — A portas fechadas.
**Under scrutiny.** — Sob escrutínio.
**Raise concerns.** — Levantar preocupações.
**Hang in the balance.** — Estar em suspenso.
**Draw the line at.** — Estabelecer limite em.
**Is a ban under consideration?** — Uma proibição está em estudo?
**I’m afraid I can’t say.** — Receio não poder dizer.
**Dr. Ferro argues it entrenches inequality.** — A Dra. Ferro argumenta que consolida a desigualdade.

items.label: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances
items.note: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances: o acento muda o sentido (He said she STOLE it × he said SHE stole it) e as pausas separam ideias técnicas densas.
words: I didn’t SAY he did it.
I didn’t say HE did it.
I didn’t say he DID it.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence news report on a fictional committee meeting, attributing each claim to a source.
blocks.model: The city’s ethics panel met on Monday to discuss drone surveillance. Councillor Ruiz argued that it threatens privacy. The police chief maintained that it prevents crime. A spokesperson declined to say whether a vote would follow. According to minutes seen by this newspaper, members were divided. The panel is expected to report in May.
